Explore Capabilities

Key Features Inside The Mobile App

Get to know the powerful utilities built inside KrushiSanjeevini designed to simplify farming.

AI Crop Suggestions

Matches soil configuration, location-based climate profiles, and humidity indices to recommend the best cash crops and seasonal vegetables for maximum output.

Pest & Disease Diagnosis

Upload or capture clear photos of affected crops. Advanced image-recognition model diagnoses root causes and outlines organic pest controls or targeted spray dosages.

Live APMC Market Rates

Real-time updates directly from government APMC portals. Track current minimum, maximum, and average rates of grains, vegetables, and fruits in your closest mandis.

Smart Tools Rentals

Rent high-quality farming devices and heavy equipment from nearby verified rental distributors. Reach them directly using built-in one-tap call dialing.

Multi-language Assistance

Farming made accessible. Switch interface settings dynamically between English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, and other regional languages.

Organic DIY Fertilizer Guide

Learn step-by-step methods to produce premium-grade organic compost, liquid bio-fertilizers, and insect repellent recipes right on your homestead.
